items.description: ANS-178 — the render gate refuses a widened `role:readonly`: check_readonly_account reads the lines of policy.csv and of every policy.*.csv key, refuses any line whose subject is role:readonly, and holds the kubecoder-subject check to all of them; witnessed by the entry's two lines (`p, role:readonly, applications, sync, */*, allow` and `g, role:readonly, role:admin`), and an overlay key binding kubecoder to role:admin, each turning a scratch render red. (Planning, verified 2026-10-03: today policy_lines reads only `policy.csv` — ArgoCDDeploy tests/render-chart.py:1240-1246 — and check_readonly_account checks only kubecoder-subject lines plus policy.default — :1249-1275.)

The committed ArgoCDDeploy render stays green under the widened check: `kc project test` in ArgoCDDeploy passes with the committed policy, which is exactly `g, pvginkel@gmail.com, role:admin` and `g, kubecoder, role:readonly` (config/prd/values.yaml:69-71).

ANS-179 — a Terraform-only FieldnotesDeploy push reaches `terraform apply`. Live proof: after FieldnotesDeploy's library bump is pushed, a commit that only edits a comment in terraform/ is pushed; Argo syncs fieldnotes-prd at that commit (`status.operationState` / `status.history` at the new SHA) and the hook Job `tf-presync-fieldnotes-prd` runs, with a no-op apply on prd — no Terraform state change. A push that changes only tfvars rides the same mechanism: the render changes with every commit.

homelab-shared's hook include renders a small ordinary, non-hook ConfigMap carrying the synced commit (`hook.revision`), so two commits of a deploy repo render differently; a consumer changes nothing but its library version; no manual step, no gate, no new credential. The Charts consumer gate asserts the ConfigMap is rendered, is not a hook, and carries the revision. (Planning, verified 2026-10-03: today the include renders only the PreSync RoleBinding and Job — Charts charts/homelab-shared/templates/_tf-presync-hook.tpl:42-90 — and hook.revision reaches only the Job's args, :85.)

The new homelab-shared version is served by https://charts.home before any deploy repo pins it, published from Charts' reviewed `main` (ruling D3); its tarball is committed in Charts dist/, and every previously published version is still served unchanged (`tests/publish.sh` green).

Every other deploy repo that pins homelab-shared is bumped to the new library version and pushed, in batches, after FieldnotesDeploy proved it live; every app-stage that deploys from `main` syncs at its repo's bump commit and its PreSync hook runs (kubecoder-prd, which deploys from `prd`, is V09). ArgoCDDeploy is not bumped.

Before pushing, every app whose terraform/ or config/*/*.tfvars changed since its last sync operation (a commit the defect left unapplied) is listed, since the bump push applies it; those apps are reported in the rollout phase's done-record. Each repo's pending-Terraform status is re-checked just before its push (ruling D4), and an app that turned at-risk in between is reported in the test phase's record.

ChartsDeploy's bump is the same library-version change as every other deploy repo's — no deploy repo commits the library tarball (AnsibleSpecs argo-cd/design.md:140); charts-prd syncs at the bump commit, its PreSync hook runs, and afterwards https://charts.home/index.yaml still lists every published homelab-shared version, the new one included.

A consumer's bump is its library version wherever the repo states it, and nothing else: the chart/Chart.yaml pin, its re-resolved Chart.lock, and any test of the repo's own that pins the version (ruling r1 F1). Each bumped repo's own `kc project test`, where it has one, runs at its bump commit and its result is in the rollout ledger; the bump turns none red. (Planning, verified 2026-10-03: KubeCoderDeploy pins the version a second time in tests/render-chart.py:26 `LIBRARY`, and check_library — :209-213, called at :522 — refuses a chart/Chart.yaml dependency list that differs from it; that script is a step of the repo's `kc project test`, .kubecoder/project.yaml `test:`.)
kubecoder-prd, which tracks KubeCoderDeploy's `prd` branch (ArgoCDDeploy releases/values.yaml:172-174), syncs at the bump once promotion carries it to `prd`, and its PreSync hook runs.
items.owed_after: the operator's next KubeCoder/Promote-PRD run, which moves KubeCoderDeploy's `prd` branch
